def VTask.prev {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  let i := l.index h
  if i = 0 then
    l.getLast (by
      have : l.Nonempty := List.nonempty_of_mem h
      exact this)
  else
    l.get ⟨i - 1, by
      have : i < l.length := List.index_lt h
      omega⟩
